instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph with soft focus and natural lighting captures a medium, eye-level shot of three young women on a sunlit dirt path in a wooded park. On the left, the young woman with a white patterned headband (R2) wears a white t-shirt and points forward with a wooden stick. In the center, the young woman in a black t-shirt (R3) holds an open paper map with a plaid shirt tied around her waist, smiling towards the left. On the right, the young woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R1) stands smiling with a beige jacket tied around her waist, holding a rolled-up purple blanket. Warm, golden hour sunlight backlights the scene, creating a soft glow on their hair and a warm, inviting atmosphere as they stand close together.
